concept: 藍紫星河連接五個知識節點；透明底標誌配合淺藍首頁。
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create exactly one finished symbol-only logo for Creative 2nd Brain, a calm elegant personal knowledge application. Primary idea: a knowledge galaxy, a flowing nebula river connecting a few knowledge nodes. One compact iconic circular-but-open swirling river silhouette, two gently interwoven broad tapered flowing arcs forming a subtle galaxy, 4 to 5 distinct round constellation nodes connected by carefully spaced fine paths within the symbol. Palette deep navy #1e3354, indigo #4e5fb3, restrained periwinkle and muted cyan highlights. Premium clear vector-like edges with restrained smooth color gradients, not a photograph. The website uses pale icy blue backgrounds, navy typography, blue-violet accents. It must remain readable as a 48px sidebar brand mark on very light backgrounds and not rely on hazy glow. Centered balanced square composition, symbol fills 85 percent of canvas, clean transparent background with actual alpha. No words, no letters, no brain anatomy, no orange, no generic AI sparkle motif, no starfield dust, no mockup, no border, no watermark. Deliver a crisp high quality transparent PNG logo, 1024 square.
